title: Ninja Crispi £99, Dyson V8 Cyclone £199 and Ninja Slushi £189
description: Tuesday's best UK deals: Ninja Crispi £99, Dyson V8 Cyclone £199, Ninja Slushi £189 and De'Longhi Rivelia £599, mostly at Amazon.
intro:
**Today's pick is the Ninja Crispi glass air fryer at £99 on Amazon, a price TechRadar doesn't expect to be beaten this Black Friday, with the Dyson V8 Cyclone holding at £199, the lowest Which? has recorded in six months.** It's a kitchen-heavy day: Ninja's Slushi, kettle and the KitchenAid hand mixer are all at record lows on Amazon, and two picks come from this week's [Black Friday vacuum deals 2026](/spotlight/black-friday-vacuum-deals-2026/) spotlight.

Prices below were published on 23 November (TechRadar's kitchen appliance roundup and UK live blog, and Which?'s Black Friday price checks) or read from PriceSpy on 24 November, so check the product page before you pay. Buy now or wait? Black Friday itself is this Friday (27 November), but on most of these there's no sign of a lower price coming, so if one's on your list, buy it.

deals.name: Ninja Crispi glass air fryer
deals.note: A compact air fryer whose glass dishes go from fryer to table to fridge, handy for one or two people. TechRadar calls £99 its lowest ever. Bigger households should see our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Dyson V8 Cyclone cordless vacuum
deals.note: The cheapest Dyson stick vacuum, fine for flats and smaller homes. PriceSpy shows Amazon at £199 today, matching the six-month low Which? reports. Which? notes this version comes with just a crevice tool, so check the box contents.

deals.name: Shark Stratos cordless vacuum (IZ400UK)
deals.note: Shark's anti-hair-wrap brush suits homes with pets or long hair, and £199 is about half its usual price (ignore the £419.99 'was'). Torn between brands? Read [Shark vs Dyson cordless](/guides/shark-vs-dyson-cordless/).

deals.name: Ninja Slushi frozen drinks maker
deals.note: Makes slushies, frozen cocktails and milkshakes at home. A fun Christmas gift for a family, and TechRadar says this is a record low at Amazon. More in our [Ninja Slushi deals](/guides/ninja-slushi-deals-uk/) guide.

deals.name: Ninja Perfect Temperature Kettle
deals.note: Lets you pick the water temperature, which matters for green tea and pour-over coffee. TechRadar says it's the cheapest it has been direct from Amazon. Other Ninja picks are in our [Ninja Black Friday guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: KitchenAid 9-Speed Hand Mixer
deals.note: A sturdy hand mixer for cakes and Christmas baking, without the cost or counter space of a stand mixer. TechRadar reports a record low at Amazon. Stand mixers are in our [KitchenAid Black Friday guide](/guides/kitchenaid-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: De'Longhi Rivelia bean-to-cup coffee machine
deals.note: Grinds and brews at the touch of a button, with two swappable bean hoppers so you can keep decaf and regular on the go. TechRadar says it's back at its record low. Compare others in our [coffee machine guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Nespresso Vertuo Next with Aeroccino milk frother
deals.note: An easy capsule machine plus a milk frother for lattes, which makes it a good starter set or gift. The £198.99 'was' is the two items' combined list price, so the saving looks bigger than it is, but £79 for both is still fair.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Mostly no. The Ninja and KitchenAid prices are at record lows, and Amazon's Black Friday Week prices run until Cyber Monday (30 November), so a deeper cut on Friday looks unlikely. If you want a Shark, Currys has the Stratos at £199 now; Amazon's Shark prices were higher earlier this week, so check the compare link on the card before you buy.

## This week's spotlight

Our [Black Friday vacuum deals 2026](/spotlight/black-friday-vacuum-deals-2026/) spotlight covers which cordless and robot vacuums are at real lows and the prices worth paying. Dyson fans should also see our [Dyson Black Friday guide](/guides/dyson-black-friday-deals-2026/), and Shark fans our [Shark Black Friday guide](/guides/shark-black-friday-deals-2026/).

Not a Prime member? Some Amazon deal prices need Prime, and a [free Prime trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the whole of Black Friday Week. For everything else, see [every Black Friday 2026 guide](/black-friday/).
